description.narrative: IFC expects the Project to (i) contribute to enhancing food and nutrition security in Sri Lanka through increasing the availability of and access to poultry meat to consumers in Sri Lanka; (ii) generate stakeholder effects for farmers as suppliers through improved livelihoods, access to market, and technical assistance and (iii) generate economy-wide effects by contributing to employment creation and stimulating forward and backward linkages with related sectors. Beyond the Project outcomes, IFC anticipates that the Project will generate a market deepening effect in the natural chicken production segment. By improving operational efficiency for a leading player in the natural poultry production sector in Sri Lanka and demonstrating viability of the Project, it can catalyze other players in the sector to replicate natural chicken production.

New Anthoney's Farms Private Limited (NAF or the Company) is a poultry farming business in Sri Lanka and consists of a feed mill, breeder farms, a hatchery, broiler farms, a network of out-growers for broiler farming, a slaughterhouse, a further processing unit, and retail shops under the Anthoney's brand. Established in 1986 as a small farm with 1,000 birds and a manual production facility, NAF has grown over the past 40 years to become one of the largest players in Sri Lanka's poultry industry. It is currently implementing a capital expenditure program for capacity expansion, improvement in operational efficiencies and expansion of its own retail network (the Project). The IFC investment will be for the purpose of partially funding this Project, in the form of a C Loan (in US$) up to US$ 5 million with an option to convert into equity shares of NAF. NAF's wholly owned subsidiary, New Anthoney's Feeds Limited and affiliate, Anthoney's Meatlery (Pvt.) Limited will be co-borrowers to the C Loan. The Project is expected to be supported by the Private Sector Window of the Global Agriculture and Food Security Program (GAFSP), as described in the Blended Finance Section.
